metadata.case_name: FUNG KWOK KI v. WING SANG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: Lift Technician II (Ryoden Elevator Co. Ltd.)

source: The clinical diagnosis was head injury, thoracic spinal injury with paralysis and fracture of left femur.

After a prolonged period of surgical and medical treatment, the plaintiff has made a partial recovery and is left with permanent residual brain damage in the form of impaired higher mental functions including dysarthria, dysphagia and mild upper limb dysfunction.
He was unconscious when admitted to hospital. He was in deep coma with Glasgow Coma Score of 3/15.

injuries.description: thoracic spinal injury with paralysis / complete spinal cord injury at T7
source: The clinical diagnosis was head injury, thoracic spinal injury with paralysis and fracture of left femur.
Physical examination showed tetraplegia with signs of complete spinal cord injury.
His neurogenic urinary and bowel disturbance are caused by the spinal cord damage at T7 level.
There is also no recovery of his paraplegia with double incontinence.
injuries.icd_description: Complete lesion of thoracic spinal cord

source: The clinical diagnosis was head injury, thoracic spinal injury with paralysis and fracture of left femur.
He ... had internal fixation of his spine and left femur.

injuries.description: neuropathic bladder / neurogenic urinary and bowel disturbance; neuropathic impotence
source: Moreover, the plaintiff has a neuropathic bladder with poor or uncoordinated detrusor contraction and without any sensation of filling or distension. He is being managed by Clean Intermittent Catheterisation five times daily.
His bowel problem needs to have continued management with laxative and suppositories. His neuropathic impotence is permanent.
His neurogenic urinary and bowel disturbance are caused by the spinal cord damage at T7 level.
injuries.icd_description: Complete lesion of thoracic spinal cord

manifestations.description: Deep coma with Glasgow Coma Score of 3/15 on admission
Tetraplegia with signs of complete spinal cord injury
Neuropathic bladder with poor or uncoordinated detrusor contraction and without any sensation of filling or distension
Permanent residual brain damage in the form of impaired higher mental functions
Mild upper limb dysfunction / left upper limb weaker than the right
Severe pressure sores (required multiple debridement and Gluteal maximus myocutaneous flap)
Will never be able to work again / full loss of earnings

treatments_received: Internal fixation of spine and left femur
Percutaneous release of contracted left middle finger
Rehabilitation (Wong Tai Sin Hospital, Kowloon Hospital)
Clean Intermittent Catheterisation (ongoing, five times daily)
treatments_future: Continued management with laxatives and suppositories

losses.description: Permanent residual brain damage in the form of impaired higher mental functions including dysarthria, dysphagia and mild upper limb dysfunction.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: In his present condition he will not be able to do minor odd jobs in the house and a handyman will have to be engaged and paid.
Requires full time domestic helper(s) and assistance at home for daily care.
The plaintiff will never be able to work again; full loss of future earnings.
Loss of society of the plaintiff by his wife (statutory award for loss of society).
